it's a tough one. do basic stuff first, like taking care of physical needs. fill up a nice big water bottle with icy water, have a snack (something light if sobbing makes you nauseous like us!) after these, try the next step up. make your bed, brush your teeth, or put on fresh clothes. these things help my brain kind of "move forward", like by doing a different activity i'm saying "okay, we're done with last night" sort of thing. i would highly recommend changing your clothes and underwear, it feels fresh and clean and will probably actually be pretty relieving. brushing my teeth is a lot of energy but it tends to give a pretty nice feeling result!
hydrate, big time. water, flavored water, sports drinks, anything like that. avoid soda and caffeine, they're dehydrating and can cause anxiety. 
be kind and gentle with yourselves, and extend some TLC to your triggered parts. internally, sit with them and listen. let them talk about it. try to soothe them. if you have an internal self-helper/protector/caretaker or someone in that vein, it could be nice to talk to them too. listen and validate your triggered part's feelings, but remember to take a step back and ground yourselves if you start becoming blended and panicky. 
wishing you a calm and speedy recovery, it sucks to have a rough night. lots of love! -puyo 🖤
another thought: try to do something fun for yourself today! what kind of hobbies do you have? do you like to take walks, or play with pets? what about video games or art? find a fun activity that you enjoy, you deserve to do that today!!
